title: Verify: BootScene keyboard unit tests for each key with Phaser mocked
summary: Mocked tests for Tab, arrows, Enter, Space, Escape and cleanup
description: New test file with Phaser mocked so Scene exposes input.keyboard {on, off} spies and events.once; buildScene mocked to return fake objects.
acceptance_criteria: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Enter, Space and Escape each have a test.
technical_constraints: Mirror the mocks in game/frontend/tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts; add input.keyboard to the mocked Scene; mock @game/engine/buildScene with buildScene and moveFocus as vi.fn

steps.action: Copy the vi.mock blocks from bootSceneSync.test.ts, extending the mocked Scene with input = { keyboard: { on: vi.fn(), off: vi.fn() } } and mocking buildScene returning one fake object {sync,destroy,onInteract,handleKey:vi.fn(),isFocused:true,spec:{id:'bookshelf'}} and moveFocus as vi.fn. In beforeEach create BootScene and call create(); grab the keydown handler from input.keyboard.on.mock.calls.
steps.code: const press = (key: string, shiftKey = false) => handler({ key, shiftKey, preventDefault: vi.fn() } as unknown as KeyboardEvent);
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts

steps.action: Add tests: Tab -> moveFocus called with (objects, 1) and focusChange emitted {id:'bookshelf'}; Shift+Tab and ArrowLeft -> -1; ArrowRight -> 1; Enter and ' ' -> fake.handleKey called with the key; Escape -> menuClose emitted via a phaserToReact.on spy; running the SHUTDOWN callback from events.once calls input.keyboard.off('keydown', handler).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts
